verdict.rationale: NVIDIA's own docs state the FP8 Transformer Engine accelerates work 'across frameworks like TensorFlow and PyTorch' (docs-21), and the CUDA Toolkit is described as the general dev/runtime stack for GPU-accelerated libraries (docs-3), implying standard framework compatibility. However, hands-on community reports specifically call out that this card's SM120 architecture lacks tmem/tcgen05 support and that 'main libraries' haven't caught up compared to SM100/B300 parts, meaning real-world framework/library support is less complete than the marketing implies. Missing for 10: an official PyTorch/TensorFlow support matrix or install guide confirming full feature parity, and independent benchmarks showing mainstream training/inference works without workarounds on SM120.
